import os, re, requests
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("executor cwd:", os.getcwd(), "| files:", [f for f in os.listdir('.') if f.endswith('.csv')][:10])

BASIC=set("KR"); PHI="LIVFM"
RE_CHELSKY=re.compile(r"(?=(K[KR].[KR]))")
RE_NES=re.compile(rf"(?=([{PHI}].{{2,3}}[{PHI}].{{2,3}}[{PHI}].[{PHI}]))")
def pat4(s):
    return [i for i in range(len(s)-3)
            if sum(c in BASIC for c in s[i:i+4])==4
            or (sum(c in BASIC for c in s[i:i+4])==3 and any(c in "HP" for c in s[i:i+4]))]
def pat7(s):
    o=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=="P":
            for off in (1,2,3):
                w=s[i+off:i+off+4]
                if len(w)==4 and sum(x in BASIC for x in w)>=3: o.append(i)
    return o
def bipart(s):
    o=[]
    for i in range(len(s)-1):
        if s[i] in BASIC and s[i+1] in BASIC:
            for sp in range(10,13):
                w=s[i+2+sp:i+2+sp+5]
                if len(w)==5 and sum(x in BASIC for x in w)>=3: o.append(i)
    return o
def counts(s): return dict(NLS_mono=len(RE_CHELSKY.findall(s)), NLS_pat4=len(pat4(s)),
                           NLS_pat7=len(pat7(s)), NLS_bipart=len(bipart(s)), NES_loose=len(RE_NES.findall(s)))
HUM=("MALLKANKDLISAGLKEFSVLLNQQVFNDPLVSEEDMVTVVEDWMNFYINYYRQQVTGEPQERDKALQELRQELNTLANPFLAKYRDFLKSHELPSHPPPSS")

ctrl_acc={"SV40 large T\n(NLS+)":"P03070","Nucleoplasmin\n(bipartite NLS+)":"P05221","UBF1\n(NLS+)":"P17480",
          "HIV-1 Rev\n(NES+)":"P04618","PKIA\n(NES+)":"P61925","MAP2K1\n(NES+)":"Q02750",
          "Histone H4\n(nuclear)":"P62805","HBA1\n(cytoplasmic)":"P69905","SOD1\n(cytoplasmic)":"P00441"}
labs=["AHSP\n(TEST)"]; mats=[counts(HUM)]; lens=[len(HUM)]
for lab,acc in ctrl_acc.items():
    s="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=30).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
    labs.append(lab); mats.append(counts(s)); lens.append(len(s))
M=pd.DataFrame(mats,index=labs); M["length"]=lens
Mn=M[["NLS_mono","NLS_pat4","NLS_pat7","NLS_bipart","NES_loose"]].div(M.length,axis=0)*100

# shuffle null
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); arr=np.array(list(HUM))
nes_null=[];nls_null=[]
for _ in range(10000):
    s="".join(rng.permutation(arr)); c=counts(s)
    nes_null.append(c["NES_loose"]); nls_null.append(c["NLS_mono"]+c["NLS_pat4"]+c["NLS_pat7"]+c["NLS_bipart"])
nes_null=np.array(nes_null)

# orthologs
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=gene:AHSP+AND+taxonomy_id:40674&format=fasta",timeout=60).text
seqs={};name=None
for line in r.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith(">"): name=line[1:]; seqs[name]=""
    elif name and line.strip(): seqs[name]+=line.strip()
clean={k:v for k,v in seqs.items() if 80<=len(v)<=120}
orow=[]
for k,s in clean.items():
    c=counts(s); c["organism"]=k.split("OS=")[1].split(" OX=")[0]; c["net_charge"]=s.count("K")+s.count("R")-s.count("D")-s.count("E")
    orow.append(c)
O=pd.DataFrame(orow)
nls_any=(O[["NLS_mono","NLS_pat4","NLS_pat7","NLS_bipart"]].sum(1)>0).sum()

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
# A
ax=axes[0,0]
x=np.arange(len(M)); w=0.17
for i,c in enumerate(["NLS_mono","NLS_pat4","NLS_pat7","NLS_bipart","NES_loose"]):
    ax.bar(x+(i-2)*w, Mn[c], w, label=c)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("motif matches per 100 aa"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("A. AHSP has zero NLS matches of any class;\nits NES-like matches are at background density",fontsize=10)
ax.axvspan(-0.5,0.5,color='#F58518',alpha=0.15)
# B
ax=axes[0,1]
ax.hist(nes_null,bins=np.arange(-0.5,13.5),color="#9ecae1",edgecolor="w")
ax.axvline(3,color="#E45756",lw=2.5)
ax.text(3.2,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,"observed in AHSP = 3\nP(shuffled >= 3) = %.2f"%(nes_null>=3).mean(),color="#E45756",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("loose leucine-rich NES matches"); ax.set_ylabel("shuffled sequences (n=10,000)")
ax.set_title("B. Composition-preserving shuffle null:\nthe 3 NES-like matches carry no signal",fontsize=10)
# C
ax=axes[1,0]
vals=[nls_any, len(O)-nls_any]
ax.bar([0,1],vals,color=["#E45756","#4C78A8"])
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["with any NLS match","no NLS match"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1,str(v),ha="center",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("mammalian AHSP orthologs")
ax.set_title("C. 0 of %d mammalian AHSP orthologs (UniProt)\ncarry a classical mono- or bipartite NLS"%len(O),fontsize=10)
# D
ax=axes[1,1]
items=[("AHSP monomer",11.84),("AHSP:alpha-globin\n1:1 complex",26.97),("GFP (free diffusion\nreference)",26.9),
       ("passive NPC\nsoft limit",40.0),("passive NPC\nhard limit",60.0)]
cols=["#4C78A8","#4C78A8","#9ecae1","#bbbbbb","#888888"]
ax.barh([i for i in range(len(items))],[v for _,v in items],color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(items))); ax.set_yticklabels([n for n,_ in items],fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(40,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("molecular mass (kDa)")
ax.set_title("D. AHSP and its alpha-globin complex are far below the\nnuclear-pore passive diffusion limit",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nNES null: mean %.2f, P(shuffled>=3)=%.3f"%(nes_null.mean(),(nes_null>=3).mean()))
print("orthologs analysed:",len(O),"with any NLS match:",nls_any,
      "| all net charge <0:",bool((O.net_charge<0).all()))
